name: com.dropbox.client2.android.AuthActivity
description: The Dropbox Android SDK opens this screen when an app starts Dropbox account authorization, handing the user to the Dropbox app or web sign-in and receiving the return. The GroundUpWorks Wings Dropbox integration uses it to connect an account for photo sharing.
disableEffect: Users cannot link or reauthorize a Dropbox account, so Wings photo sharing to Dropbox may fail.
